title: Processing Plant 4 Toxic Acid Spill
transcript: Emergency in Processing Plant 4 Bay 2. A 55-gallon drum of hydrochloric acid ruptured during forklift transit. Dave Miller and Sarah Connor were exposed to fumes and are receiving medical triage. We evacuated the bay and shut off the ventilation.

ground_truth.incidentDescription: A 55-gallon drum of hydrochloric acid ruptured during forklift transit
ground_truth.immediate_actions_taken: Evacuated the bay and shut off the ventilation

title: Substation B Transformer Explosion
transcript: Critical alert at Substation B! Main transformer 2 exploded around 10:15 AM. Flames spreading to the switchgear room. John Miller got severe flash burns. We hit the master grid trip switch immediately. Witnessed by electrician Marcus Vance.

ground_truth.incidentDescription: Main transformer 2 exploded and flames spreading to switchgear room

title: Warehouse 3 Forklift Rack Collision
transcript: Reporting an accident in Warehouse 3 aisle 14. An electric forklift hit racking column C4. The lower beam bent and pallets of steel fasteners are leaning dangerously. Operator was Leo Gomez, no injuries. Racking needs immediate ultrasonic inspection.

ground_truth.incidentDescription: Forklift hit racking column C4 causing beam to bend and pallets to lean

title: Break Room False Alarm (All Unstated Null)
transcript: Someone burned popcorn in the 2nd floor administration break room. The optical smoke detector triggered briefly, but there is zero damage and no fire.

ground_truth.incidentDescription: Burned popcorn triggered optical smoke detector briefly with zero damage

title: Multi-Turn Correction Case
transcript: Fire in Storage Unit 3. Medium severity.

multi_turn.follow_up_transcript: Actually correction, it was in Storage Unit 4, not 3, and occurred at 3:30 PM.
